_summary: Out-of-corpus BGH cases the baselines cite: 16. **Exist (9):** 6 are on the portal table of contents, and 3 more are confirmed because a corpus judgment cites them. **Not found (5):** 156/10, 216/15, 268/14, 278/19 and 379/11 carry a year of 2010 or later but are missing from the table. That strongly suggests they are invented, but doesn't prove it. **Can't be checked locally (2):** 103/06 and 137/03 predate the portal. 137/03 is probably a garbled number: its date, 7 April 2004, and its topic match VIII ZR 167/03, which BGH VIII ZR 137/15, Rn. 11 cites. **Topics of the 9 that exist:** 1 consistent with the baseline's claim (340/10), 3 partly matching (137/09, 202/06, 266/14), 1 on a different subject altogether (107/13), and 4 that can't be told from local files. Two of the not-found numbers are cited for the smoke-detector-rental holding of VIII ZR 379/20 in the corpus: 379/11 looks like a garbled version of that number, and 216/15 has no visible link to it. Sources: corpus/raw/bgh_toc/rii-toc.xml, corpus/raw/bgh_screen/ and the corpus judgments' own citations; no API calls.

VIII ZR 103/06.claimed: Repeatedly ruled that an on-call caretaker fee is maintenance/management (q16)
VIII ZR 103/06.actual: Not checkable from local files; no corpus judgment cites it

VIII ZR 107/13.claimed: Tenant loses the refund claim once the 12-month objection deadline passes (q07)
VIII ZR 107/13.actual: Summary dismissal for an invented previous-landlord reference; notice to an insolvent tenant (Leitsatz, local portal file)

VIII ZR 115/04.claimed: Commercial share must be deducted first (Vorwegabzug) where commercial use raises costs (q17)
VIII ZR 115/04.actual: Cited in 249/15 for the purpose of the annual statement: the tenant must learn the balance; the Vorwegabzug point can't be confirmed locally

VIII ZR 137/03.claimed: "die Betriebskosten" alone is a valid clause (q31)
VIII ZR 137/03.actual: Not found. The same date and point match VIII ZR 167/03 (7 April 2004), cited in BGH VIII ZR 137/15, Rn. 11, for referring to Anlage 3 to § 27 II. BV

VIII ZR 137/09.claimed: Waste management / sorting services are waste disposal costs under § 2 Nr. 8 BetrKV (q02, q31)
VIII ZR 137/09.actual: Removal of unlawfully dumped bulky waste (Sperrmüll) is a § 2 Nr. 8 waste disposal cost (cited in BGH VIII ZR 117/21 and 230/21)
VIII ZR 137/09.matches: partly (right category, different facts; the sorting holding is VIII ZR 117/21)

VIII ZR 156/10.claimed: WEG approval of the annual statement is not a precondition for billing the tenant (q11)
VIII ZR 156/10.actual: Not in the portal table; the corpus holding on this point is VIII ZR 249/15

VIII ZR 202/06.claimed: Landmark ruling that the bare term "Betriebskosten" suffices without listing or citing the statute (q05)
VIII ZR 202/06.actual: A reference to Anlage 3 to § 27 II. BV or the BetrKV suffices (137/15 Rn. 11); the bare-term holding is VIII ZR 137/15 (2016)
VIII ZR 202/06.matches: partly (real case, right date, holding attributed one step too far)

VIII ZR 202/10.claimed: Formal vs. substantive validity of a statement for a WEG flat (q29)
VIII ZR 202/10.actual: Topic not in local files (no local copy, not cited in the corpus)

VIII ZR 216/15.claimed: Smoke detector rental fees are capital costs and can't be passed on (q03)
VIII ZR 216/15.actual: Not in the portal table; that holding is VIII ZR 379/20 (2022), in the corpus

VIII ZR 223/10.claimed: The WEG manager is not the landlord's vicarious agent (q12)
VIII ZR 223/10.actual: Topic not in local files; the corpus holding on this point is VIII ZR 249/15

VIII ZR 227/09.claimed: A statement is formally valid when it shows only the adjusted total (q18)
VIII ZR 227/09.actual: Topic not in local files; the corpus holding on this point is VIII ZR 93/15

VIII ZR 266/14.claimed: You can't raise the base rent just because the flat turns out bigger (q30)
VIII ZR 266/14.actual: Rent increases under § 558 use the actual size, subject to the cap (Kappungsgrenze) (Leitsatz, local portal file; cited in BGH VIII ZR 220/17)
VIII ZR 266/14.matches: partly (right case and topic, holding stated loosely)

VIII ZR 268/14.claimed: Landmark ruling that vacancy-driven heat losses can't be passed to remaining tenants (q19)
VIII ZR 268/14.actual: Not in the portal table; the corpus holdings on vacancy are VIII ZR 151/20 and 9/14

VIII ZR 278/19.claimed: Formal vs. substantive validity of a statement for a WEG flat (q29)

VIII ZR 340/10.claimed: A Betriebskostenspiegel alone is usually not enough to prove a breach of the economy principle (q10)
VIII ZR 340/10.actual: Economy principle; the tenant bears the burden of proving the breach (cited in BGH VIII ZR 230/21 Leitsatz and 117/21)

VIII ZR 379/11.claimed: Set the precedent that smoke detector rental can't be passed on (q26)
VIII ZR 379/11.actual: Not in the portal table; the precedent is VIII ZR 379/20 (2022), in the corpus, so this is likely a garbled 379/20
